name: Temporary Residence Permit (Family Reunification)

requirements.blocker_text: Kosovo Border Police brochure: family reunification (including cohabitation-based relationships, not only marriage) is one of the named grounds for a Temporary Residence Permit, valid 1 year and renewable. A joining spouse who marries a Kosovo citizen or permanent resident, and who accumulates the residence period, qualifies for Permanent Residence after only 3 years instead of the standard 5.
requirements.fix_path: Have the sponsor (a Kosovo citizen, resident, or permit holder) support the application; the joining family member applies for a Temporary Residence Permit on family-reunification/cohabitation grounds.

evidence_required.document: Proof of qualifying family relationship (marriage/birth certificate or proof of cohabitation)
Sponsor's proof of status in Kosovo

sources.title: Kosovo Police (official government body) -- Temporary Residence Permit categories including family reunification/cohabitation, and the reduced 3-year permanent-residence threshold for marriage to a citizen or resident

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Kosovo). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- hard requirement sourced directly to Kosovo Police's own official brochure, tier 1. GENUINE FINDING: Kosovo explicitly recognizes cohabitation, not only formal marriage, as a family-reunification ground for temporary residence -- a more permissive framing than most other countries built in this dataset. pr_after_months set to 36 (not 60) since this file specifically models the marriage/family route, which the source confirms gets the reduced 3-year permanent-residence threshold rather than the general 5-year one (see xk_work_permit.json for the general case). family_can_work left null: not addressed by the source.
